verses.text: In Judah, God is known. His name is great in Israel.
lines: In Judah, God is known.
His name is great in Israel.

verses.text: His tabernacle is also in Salem; His dwelling place in Zion.
lines: His tabernacle is also in Salem;
His dwelling place in Zion.

verses.text: There he broke the flaming arrows of the bow, the shield, and the sword, and the weapons of war.
lines: There he broke the flaming arrows of the bow,
the shield, and the sword, and the weapons of war.

verses.text: Glorious are you, and excellent, more than mountains of game.
lines: Glorious are you, and excellent,
more than mountains of game.

verses.text: Valiant men lie plundered, they have slept their last sleep. None of the men of war can lift their hands.
lines: Valiant men lie plundered,
they have slept their last sleep.
None of the men of war can lift their hands.

verses.text: At your rebuke, God of Jacob, both chariot and horse are cast into a dead sleep.
lines: At your rebuke, God of Jacob,
both chariot and horse are cast into a dead sleep.

verses.text: You, even you, are to be feared. Who can stand in your sight when you are angry?
lines: You, even you, are to be feared.
Who can stand in your sight when you are angry?

verses.text: You pronounced judgment from heaven. The earth feared, and was silent,
lines: You pronounced judgment from heaven.
The earth feared, and was silent,

verses.text: when God arose to judgment, to save all the afflicted ones of the earth.
lines: when God arose to judgment,
to save all the afflicted ones of the earth.

verses.text: Surely the wrath of man praises you. The survivors of your wrath are restrained.
lines: Surely the wrath of man praises you.
The survivors of your wrath are restrained.

verses.text: Make vows to Yahweh your God, and fulfill them! Let all of his neighbors bring presents to him who is to be feared.
lines: Make vows to Yahweh your God, and fulfill them!
Let all of his neighbors bring presents to him who is to be feared.

verses.text: He will cut off the spirit of princes. He is feared by the kings of the earth.
lines: He will cut off the spirit of princes.
He is feared by the kings of the earth.
